hero.title: Behind every condition, there is a person.
hero.description: I'm Mohamed Gamil, and I believe effective physiotherapy begins with listening before treatment. My goal is to make every patient feel understood and know why each step of their recovery matters.
hero.imageAlt: Dr. Mohamed Gamil smiling in a clinical setting

identity.title: A career built on science and precision
identity.description: Over a decade of clinical practice, combining evidence-based protocols with a deeply human approach to rehabilitation.

bio.title: Who I am
bio.p1: I'm Dr. Mohamed Gamil, a licensed physiotherapist and rehabilitation specialist. My practice focuses on restoring movement, reducing pain, and guiding patients back to the activities they love.
bio.p2: I combine modern biomechanical analysis with evidence-based therapeutic protocols, always keeping the patient's long-term independence at the center of every decision.

sports.title: Sports Injuries
sports.description: Return-to-play programs for athletes of all levels.

chronic.title: Chronic Pain
chronic.description: Long-term management of persistent musculoskeletal pain.

preventive.title: Preventive Care
preventive.description: Movement screening and injury prevention programs.

philosophy.title: The Values Governing Every Clinical Decision
philosophy.description: Three principles shape how I approach every patient, every session, and every recovery plan.

dignity.title: Movement as Human Dignity
dignity.description: The ability to walk, play, and live without fear is not a luxury — it is the core of physical and psychological autonomy.

precision.title: Precision Over Haste
precision.description: No magical shortcuts. Each therapeutic phase respects biological healing timelines and objective mechanical metrics.

sufficiency.title: Patient Self-Sufficiency
sufficiency.description: The greatest therapist renders themselves unnecessary. We empower you with lifetime movement self-management.

credentials.title: Education, certifications & experience
credentials.description: A foundation built on academic training, internationally recognized certifications, and years of clinical practice.

bachelor.title: BSc in Physical Therapy
bachelor.note: Graduated with honors. Specialized in musculoskeletal rehabilitation from the final year.

master.title: MSc in Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation
master.note: Thesis on biomechanical outcomes of return-to-sport protocols in amateur athletes.

phd.title: PhD in Movement Science
phd.note: Research focus: integrating objective motion analysis into clinical decision-making.

clinic1.title: Staff Physiotherapist
clinic1.note: Managed a caseload of 30+ patients per week, focusing on post-surgical rehabilitation.

hospital.title: Senior Rehabilitation Specialist
hospital.note: Led the outpatient musculoskeletal team. Designed hospital-wide post-op recovery protocols.

sports.title: Sports Rehabilitation Consultant
sports.note: Working with national teams on injury prevention and return-to-play decision-making.

academic.title: Clinical Instructor
academic.org: Cairo University — Faculty of Physical Therapy
academic.note: Teaching advanced manual therapy and clinical reasoning to postgraduate students.

clinical.title: A sanctuary engineered for focus and healing
clinical.description: We recognize that clinical anxiety restricts autonomic healing. Our private practice spaces are designed as serene sanctuaries — free of hospital noise and crowded waiting halls — prioritizing peace, privacy, and dedicated physician focus.
clinical.imageAlt: The clinic's calm, private treatment room

schedule.title: Appointment-only schedule
schedule.description: Strict 1-on-1 scheduling with zero waiting time.

equipment.title: Objective assessment tools
equipment.description: Advanced motion capture and dynamometric testing.

quiet.title: Quiet, private rooms
quiet.description: No hospital noise, no crowded waiting areas.
